name: Granola
tagline: Meeting notes that stay notes unless you act on them
painPoints: Mac only: no Windows, web, or mobile path for mixed teams
Notes hold action items but do not push them to task tools on their own
No pre-meeting briefings from inbox and calendar context
No email triage, drafting, or follow-up automation
Closed-source app with no self-hosted option for regulated teams
metaTitle: Best Granola Alternative: Notes Into Action
metaDescription: Looking for a Granola alternative? GAIA is open-source AI that turns meetings into tasks, email, and workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Granola makes the meeting note better. You still take notes, Granola structures them, and then the work stops at the note. Action items sit in the note until you copy them out, follow-ups wait until you write them, and the calendar never hears about any of it. People looking for a Granola alternative want the meeting to trigger the work: tasks filed, emails drafted, and briefings ready before the next call.
gaiaReplaces: Turning meeting outcomes into tasks in Todoist, Linear, or Jira
Pre-meeting briefings from inbox and calendar history
Post-meeting follow-up emails drafted from context
Manual copy of action items from notes to tools
gaiaAdvantages: Converts meeting outcomes into tasks, emails, and docs automatically

faqs.question: Does GAIA enhance notes like Granola?
faqs.answer: GAIA takes a different path. Instead of polishing notes taken during the call, GAIA prepares briefings before the call and files tasks and follow-up emails after it. You can paste Granola notes into GAIA and it will act on their content.

faqs.question: Is GAIA private like Granola local processing?
faqs.answer: Granola processes audio on your Mac by default. GAIA self-hosted keeps all data on your own infrastructure, which gives a comparable privacy guarantee with broader automation. Hosted GAIA processes data in the cloud like other SaaS tools.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work on Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA runs on web, desktop for Mac and Windows, and mobile. Granola is Mac only, which blocks mixed OS teams.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?
faqs.answer: GAIA has a free tier and Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, with self-hosting free. You pay for automation across tools, not just note enhancement.
